## 4100 - 4105

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04101">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4101 MD - Missing data detected</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04101">

This exception is generated when a gap in periodic data is detected on a meter. The exception is generated only for the first periodic record within the gap of missing data. For example, if a meter has a daily resolution and data from January 1st – January 5th and then data from January 9th – EOM then a missing data exception is generated for January 6.

| Effective Date      | Volume | Exception Details               |
|---------------------|:------:|---------------------------------|
| 01/05/2022 07:00:00 |  100   | \-                              |
| 01/06/2022 07:00:00 |   \-   | 4101 MD - Missing Data Detected |
| 01/07/2022 07:00:00 |   \-   | \-                              |
| 01/08/2022 07:00:00 |   \-   | \-                              |
| 01/09/2022 07:00:00 |  100   | \-                              |

To resolve this exception the missing periodic records must be filled in manually or by importing late data. Once new flow data has been saved, FLOWCAL will validate the entire time frame for missing data. For example, if only part of a missing time frame is filled in (including the record that holds the exception) then the original exception will be resolved and a new exception generated at the new start to the missing data time frame.

| Effective Date      | Volume | Exception Details               |
|---------------------|:------:|---------------------------------|
| 01/05/2022 07:00:00 |  100   | \-                              |
| 01/06/2022 07:00:00 |  100   | Resolved - 4101 MD              |
| 01/07/2022 07:00:00 |   \-   | 4101 MD – Missing Data Detected |
| 01/08/2022 07:00:00 |   \-   | \-                              |
| 01/09/2022 07:00:00 |  100   | \-                              |

If only part of the missing time frame is filled in that does NOT include the record that holds the missing data exception then the original exception will remain unresolved until that record has been filled in.

| Effective Date | Volume | Exception Details |
|----|:--:|----|
| 01/05/2022 07:00:00 | 100 | \- |
| 01/06/2022 07:00:00 | \- | 4101 MD - Missing Data Detected |
| 01/07/2022 07:00:00 | 100 | \- |
| 01/08/2022 07:00:00 | <span style="color: #ff8c00;">100</span> | \- |
| 01/09/2022 07:00:00 | 100 | \- |

If the missing data timeframe crosses the month boundary line, then an exception is still only generated on the first record of the missing time frame. For example, if a gap in data begins before the end of one month, and extends through the beginning of the next month, only one exception is generated on the first missing record of the time span. In the below example the Contract Hour is 7 and Contract Day is 1.

| Effective Date      | Volume | Exception Details               |
|---------------------|:------:|---------------------------------|
| 01/29/2022 07:00:00 |  100   | \-                              |
| 01/30/2022 07:00:00 |   \-   | 4101 MD - Missing Data Detected |
| 01/31/2022 07:00:00 |   \-   | \-                              |
| 02/01/2022 07:00:00 |   \-   | \-                              |
| 02/02/2022 07:00:00 |   \-   | \-                              |
| 02/03/2022 07:00:00 |  100   | \-                              |

FLOWCAL follows the same behavior for resolving and re-validating missing data across the month boundary line as it does for time frames within the same month. If the remainder of the first month is populated, but there is still missing data in the next month, then the initial exception is resolved and a new exception is created at the new starting point of the missing data gap.

| Effective Date      | Volume | Exception Details               |
|---------------------|:------:|---------------------------------|
| 01/29/2022 07:00:00 |  100   | \-                              |
| 01/30/2022 07:00:00 |  100   | Resolved - 4101 MD              |
| 01/31/2022 07:00:00 |  100   | \-                              |
| 02/01/2022 07:00:00 |   \-   | 4101 MD - Missing Data Detected |
| 02/02/2022 07:00:00 |   \-   | \-                              |
| 02/03/2022 07:00:00 |  100   | \-                              |

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04102">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4102 MD - Data has been auto estimated</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04102">

This exception is generated for a meter when the data for the period missing data is auto-estimated by the Auto Estimate service. This exception is generated only for the first effective date of the auto-estimated data. Auto Estimate is enabled for the meter, and the Log Missing Data In Exceptions Log is set to Yes on the Auto Estimate sub-tab in the Meter Editor.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04103">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4103 Rescan - SCADA request has been queued for the meter</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04103">

This exception is generated for a meter by the Auto Rescan service when the service processes a SCADA Request for a meter. SCADA Request is enabled for meter, and the Log Rescan Data In Exceptions Log is set to Yes on the SCADA Request sub-tab in the Meter Editor.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04104">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4104 Rescan - Missing (late) data detected</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04104">

This exception is generated for a meter by the Auto Rescan service when the service finds missing periodic records prior to the current record being processed. Late Data Exception is enabled, and Generated Late Data Exception After values are set in the Meter Editor Late Data Services tab. For example, Generate Late Data Exception After values are set to 1 Day. As the Auto Rescan service processes the 1/10/2016 12:00:00 record, it will check records from 1/9/2016 12:00:00 to 1/10/2016 11:00:00. As soon as it finds the first periodic record missing, it will generate this exception for the 1/10/2016 12:00:00 record.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04105">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4105 MD - Missing source data detected</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04105">

This exception is generated when a gap in data is detected on a quality source. This exception is generated for the validation timeframe as determined by the source type. This validation only applies to gas quality sources.

Inhibited data is considered to be missing in the case of this exception.

| Effective Date | Data | Exception Details |
|----|:--:|----|
| 01/01/2025 07:00 - 01/12/2025 07:00 | Uninhibited Data | \- |
| 01/12/2025 07:00 - 01/13/2025 07:00 | No Data | 4105 MD - Missing source data detected |
| 01/13/2025 07:00 - 01/19/2025 07:00 | Uninhibited Data | \- |
| 01/19/2025 07:00 - 01/19/2025 10:00 | Inhibited Data | 4105 MD - Missing source data detected |
| 01/19/2025 10:00 - 01/31/2025 07:00 | Uninhibited Data | \- |

</div>

</div>
